description: Fetches a site's robots.txt and tests whether a given crawler may fetch a given path, following RFC 9309. Also lists the Sitemap lines and parser warnings.

path.description: Path (and query) to test, starting with /. Defaults to /.

url.description: A website address such as https://example.com or just example.com. Only public sites on the standard ports can be checked.

user_agent.description: Crawler token such as Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot or ClaudeBot. Defaults to Googlebot.

name: robots_txt_test
title: robots.txt tester
